description: Resolve a company name or partial ticker to Finnhub stock symbols. The entry point for every other tool — users say "Microsoft", the rest of the surface needs "MSFT". Returns matched symbols with display symbol, description, and security type, best likely-US match first. Each result carries isLikelyUS, a symbol-format heuristic for likely free-tier availability; quote and profile responses remain authoritative.

limit.description: Max symbols to return (Finnhub often returns 10–50 matches for a common word). Default 10. Likely-US Common Stock matches are surfaced first.

query.description: Company name (e.g., "Apple"), partial name ("micro"), or ticker fragment, up to 20 characters. Finnhub full-text matches across symbols and descriptions. Use this first when you have a company name, not a ticker — the rest of the tools need a symbol.

name: finnhub_search_symbols

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

notice.description: Guidance when nothing matched the query.

results.description: Matched symbols, likely-US Common Stock first, then by Finnhub order.

displaySymbol.description: Human-facing ticker as shown on its exchange (e.g., "AAPL", "603020.SS").

isLikelyUS.description: Symbol-format heuristic for likely US free-tier availability. Plain tickers and `.A`/`.B` class-share symbols are likely US; recognized exchange suffixes such as `.SS`, `.T`, and `.L` are not. Quote and profile responses remain authoritative.

symbol.description: Finnhub symbol — pass this to finnhub_get_quote / _company / _earnings / _news / _recommendations.

type.description: Security type (e.g., "Common Stock", "ETP", "ETF"). Empty string when Finnhub omits it.

totalCount.description: Total matches Finnhub reported (its `count`), before the limit.

truncated.description: True when more matches existed than the limit returned.

title: Finnhub Search Symbols
